messages:
Priya Kapoor: Heads-up — change window tonight 23:00 PT. Release v2.3.0 scheduled. Running prompt-eval gate now; deploybot will attempt promote at 23:05 if gate passes. Please monitor and call out any route-specific regressions.

DeployBot: Eval gate started for release v2.3.0. Running prompt-suite: summarizer, search-rerank, embeddings. Estimated completion ~5m.

qa-bot: prompt-suite finished. Summary: summarizer rouge delta -3.2% (threshold -2.5%) -> FAIL; search-rerank p@1 -0.6% (within threshold); embeddings cos-sim -0.1% (within threshold). Flagging summarizer regression, top failing prompt buckets: long-form >=200 tokens.

Jamal Chen: Oof, summarizer drop is non-trivial. Any quick hypothesis? dataset skew or model quant change?

Maya Li: Quick check: regression concentrated on long-form system prompts and bullet-summary style. v2.3.0 included a new quant profile + attention kernel tweak. Suspect quant.

Alex R.: Can we avoid holding the whole release? Route-based pin for /summarize sounds reasonable so other routes can go.

DeployBot: To pin a route, run: `/deploy pin-route --route /summarize --from v2.3.0 --to v2.2.7 --until manual`
Dry-run validated, awaiting human approval.

Priya Kapoor: Jamal/Maya, can you triage a fast bisect? If it's the quant/profile, we'll pin /summarize and proceed for others.

Jamal Chen: K, starting bisect on v2.3.0 vs v2.2.7 focusing on quant-enabled builds. Sampling 500 long-form prompts. ETA ~20m.

qa-bot: Created issue RED-1234 with metric diffs and top 25 failure examples: https://trello/RED-1234. Attaching eval run ids for traceability.

Maya Li: Ops, any infra cost or perf hit if we pin one route to older model while promoting the rest?

Ops Sam: No infra impact. Route pin is a routing-layer config change; no extra GPUs needed. CPU cost negligible.

Alex R.: Suggested rollout: promote v2.3.0 to 50% global except /summarize pinned to v2.2.7; monitor latency & quality for 30m; if green, finish 100%. Keeps blast radius small.

Priya Kapoor: Sounds good. Jamal, update when bisect has signal. If it's quant, we may re-run quant compile with fallback.

Jamal Chen: First bisect pass done: confirms degradation tied to the new quant profile (mm8g-lite) on long sequences. Reproducible on local A100 runs.

DeployBot: Pin dry-run complete. To apply pin: `/deploy pin-route apply 4401234567`

Priya Kapoor: Confirm apply. `/deploy pin-route apply 4401234567` :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Pin applied. Route /summarize -> v2.2.7 pinned until manual unpin by ops/product. Promotion of v2.3.0 proceeding for all other routes (staged rollout start).

qa-bot: Noted. Updating release notes draft: "v2.3.0 promoted with summarizer pinned to v2.2.7 pending further QA. Known regression: summarizer quality delta on long-form prompts; under investigation (likely quant profile)."

Maya Li: Filing hotfix ticket RED-1235 to repro quant compile differences and prepare alternative quant profile.

Priya Kapoor: Thanks everyone. I'll update the public release notes and post a follow-up in #release-notes once RED-1235 has an ETA or we unpin. If bisect shows quick fix, we can re-run eval gate and unpin during the window.

Jamal Chen: Will add bisect artifacts to RED-1234 and ping when we have a candidate quant profile. ETA for candidate: ~4h.

Ops Sam: I'll leave the pin in place and monitor routing logs for any anomalies.

Alex R.: Good job moving fast and keeping the rest of the release flowing. :thumbsup:

Priya Kapoor: Closing thread for now — will reopen if anything changes.
